workspace.text:

- Mon 09:00-10:00: Elena busy entire time (09:00-10:00), David busy entire time
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Elena busy entire time, David busy entire time
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Elena busy, David busy
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David busy entire time (15:00-15:30 Partner lunch, 15:30-16:00 Busy)
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Elena busy entire time, David busy entire time

There appears to be no overlap. Could you double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars for any other possible 30-min windows next week? Or should we consider reporting this as infeasible?
